notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two leaves of the upper cabinet are reported separately; their closing actions occur within the same short sampled interval, so their individual off-frame ordering is approximate.
scene_description: A person surveys a narrow modern kitchen, then opens and closes a drawer beside the refrigerator, separately opens and closes both leaves of an upper cabinet above the cooktop, and finally opens and closes a drawer beneath the air fryer.
